description: [PAID $0.02 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Buy a time pass. After one x402 payment (USDC on Base) you receive a signed token valid for N hours (default 24, max 168). Send it as the X-Novarithm-Pass header on ANY Novarithm paid endpoint and you are served immediately, with no further payment, until it expires. Designed for polling agents: one payment replaces every per-call micropayment during the window. A pass never covers /agents/pro/ subscriptions and is never charged on errors.
name: pass_time
